svg.title: Nine steps on one study
svg.desc: Cohen and Frazzini's 2008 customer-supplier study laid against the nine lines of the LIA cycle, with what the paper did at each step, the figures it reports, and where it departs.
svg.text: EDGELESS LAB / LATENT INFORMATION ARCHAEOLOGY / PLATE IV-03-1
One finance study, read against the nine lines of the cycle
Cohen and Frazzini (2008) wrote to the standards of their own field, not to LIA. The paper does most of the nine things in the order shown, says in print how it did
each one, and departs at the eighth.
STEP, AND WHAT THE PAPER DID
Artifact: disclosures of principal customers. Period: 1980 to 2004. Inclusion: the firm is in
CRSP/Compustat with book and market equity, and the customer is itself a traded firm. Stated
gap: the rules require major customers, not major suppliers, so the links run one way.
Disclosures taken from the Compustat segment files; customers with no unique match dropped
under a stated rule. The matched table of links is not printed.
Before 1998 most customers appeared as abbreviations that varied across firms and years. A
phonetic string-matching algorithm listed possible matches and a person chose by name,
Detect gaps, anomalies, and possible connections
The gap between a public fact and a price. Callaway Golf, half of Coastcast's sales, lost 30 percent
of its market value in two days in June 2001. Coastcast's price did not move for about two
loses 30 percent in two days, June 2001
no move for about two months
schematic durations, not a price chart
A general statement that can fail: prices underreact to news about linked firms. The rule
attached: buy the fifth of suppliers whose customers did best last month, sell short the fifth
buy fifth of suppliers whose customers did best
sell short fifth of suppliers whose customers did worst
Own-firm momentum, industry momentum, earlier lead-lag effects and thin trading each named
and controlled. Tests rerun on suppliers larger than their customers, and on stocks that traded
every day for the previous 12 months.
Validate or classify the remaining uncertainty
Says where it stops: the fund regression is silent about causality, and for value-weighted sorts on
one-year customer returns no predictability cannot be rejected. Retrospective and observational;
Findings published with the procedure. Several checks were run and not shown, results available
on request, among them predictability from supplier to customer. Here the study departs from
rejected or unshown checks: available from the authors on request
The paper recommends further research on investor attention and does not return to the corpus.
Once in print, the link and its test became artifacts for any later excavation.
Source: Cohen and Frazzini 2008, Journal of Finance (ledger RB-001); LIA long-form, Chapter IV-03. The cycle's step names are LIA's own wording.
